changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS roadmap_rules ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, created_by VARCHAR(50), updated_by VARCHAR(50), min_percent DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, max_percent DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, difficulties VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE );
